description: Source code for the DisplayEGL class, implementing EGL display functionalities for ANGLE graphics library, including context initialization, extension generation, and resource creation.

classes.name: DisplayEGL
classes.description: Implements EGL display functionalities for ANGLE, managing context creation, extension support, and resource management.

methods.name: getVendorString
methods.description: Returns the vendor string of the EGL implementation.

methods.description: Initializes an EGL context with specified attributes and sharing options.

methods.description: Sets capabilities for the EGL display, such as NPOT texture support.
